questions.stem: A new developer at Contoso says Git and GitHub are the same tool and asks why the team needs both. Which statement best describes the difference?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的一名新开发者说 Git 和 GitHub 是同一个工具，并问团队为什么两者都需要。哪种说法最能描述它们的区别？
options: GitHub is the version-control engine; Git is only its website.
Git tracks history locally; GitHub hosts repositories and adds pull requests and issues.
Git needs a network connection; GitHub works offline on each computer.
Git and GitHub are two names for the same Microsoft product.
questions.explain: Git is the local version-control system and GitHub is the hosting service around it, because Git records commits on your own computer while GitHub stores a shared copy and adds pull requests, issues and permissions.
questions.zhExplain: Git 是本地的版本控制系统，GitHub 是围绕它的托管服务，因为 Git 在你自己的电脑上记录提交，而 GitHub 保存共享副本并提供 pull request、issue 和权限等功能。

questions.stem: A developer at Fabrikam edits two files, and git status lists them in red. What must happen before these changes become part of the repository history?
questions.zhStem: Fabrikam 的一名开发者修改了两个文件，git status 用红色列出它们。这些改动要成为仓库历史的一部分，必须先发生什么？
options: Run git push, which commits and uploads them in one step.
Nothing; saving the files adds them to the history automatically.
Run git commit only; red files are committed directly.
Run git add to stage them, then git commit to record the snapshot.
questions.explain: The files must be staged with git add and then committed with git commit, because a change moves from the working tree to the staging area and only a commit puts the staged snapshot into the repository.
questions.zhExplain: 文件必须先用 git add 暂存，再用 git commit 提交，因为改动是从工作区进入暂存区，只有提交才会把暂存的快照放进仓库。

questions.stem: During a code review at Contoso, a team member asks what Git actually stores when someone makes a commit. Which answer is correct?
questions.zhStem: 在 Contoso 的一次代码评审中，一名成员问有人提交时 Git 实际保存了什么。哪个答案正确？
options: A snapshot of tracked files, metadata such as author and message, and a parent pointer.
Only the lines that changed, with no author or time information.
A copy of the whole computer disk at that moment.
Only the commit message; the files stay in the working tree.
questions.explain: A commit records a snapshot, metadata and a pointer to its parent, because the snapshot keeps the file state, the metadata says who and when, and the parent pointer links commits into a history.
questions.zhExplain: 提交记录了快照、元数据和指向父提交的指针，因为快照保存文件状态，元数据说明是谁在何时提交，父指针把提交连成历史。

questions.stem: A Tailwind Traders developer has edited README.md on a new branch and wants the change to appear on GitHub. Which command order is correct?
questions.zhStem: Tailwind Traders 的一名开发者在新分支上修改了 README.md，想让改动出现在 GitHub 上。哪种命令顺序正确？
options: git push, then git add, then git commit
git commit, then git push, then git add
git add, then git commit, then git push
git status, then git push, then git switch
questions.explain: The order is git add, git commit, git push, because add stages the change, commit records the staged snapshot, and push uploads the local commits to the remote repository.
questions.zhExplain: 顺序是 git add、git commit、git push，因为 add 暂存改动，commit 记录暂存的快照，push 把本地提交上传到远程仓库。

questions.stem: A student at Contoso Academy writes a long lab report and plans to make a single commit at the very end. What is the main benefit of committing after each section instead?
questions.zhStem: Contoso Academy 的一名学生在写一份很长的实验报告，打算在最后只提交一次。改为每完成一节就提交一次，主要好处是什么？
options: It makes the repository smaller on GitHub.
The history shows how the work grew, and earlier states can be restored.
It removes the need to push the branch to GitHub.
It merges each section into main automatically.
questions.explain: Small commits give a useful history, because each commit is a saved snapshot, so the log shows how the report grew and any earlier state can be recovered.
questions.zhExplain: 小步提交能留下有用的历史，因为每次提交都是一个保存的快照，所以日志能显示报告如何逐步完成，也能恢复任何早期状态。

questions.stem: Contoso's team lead asks every developer to run git switch -c feature-login instead of committing straight to main. Why?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的团队负责人要求每个开发者运行 git switch -c feature-login，而不是直接提交到 main。为什么？
options: Work stays off main until it is reviewed and merged.
Commits on a branch do not need a commit message.
A branch uploads changes to GitHub without git push.
Branches delete the main branch after the work is finished.
questions.explain: A working branch keeps unreviewed changes away from main, because commits made on the branch only reach main when the branch is reviewed and merged.
questions.zhExplain: 工作分支能让未经评审的改动远离 main，因为分支上的提交只有在评审并合并后才会进入 main。

questions.stem: A developer at Fabrikam has three local commits on branch lab-01 and runs git push -u origin lab-01. What does this do?
questions.zhStem: Fabrikam 的一名开发者在 lab-01 分支上有三个本地提交，并运行了 git push -u origin lab-01。这条命令做了什么？
options: It merges lab-01 into main on GitHub.
It downloads the latest commits from GitHub into lab-01.
It creates a pull request from lab-01 automatically.
It uploads the local commits so the branch also exists on GitHub.
questions.explain: Push uploads the branch's local commits to the remote, because git push sends commits to origin, and -u also sets origin/lab-01 as the branch's upstream.
questions.zhExplain: push 把分支的本地提交上传到远程，因为 git push 会把提交发送到 origin，而 -u 还会把 origin/lab-01 设为该分支的上游。

questions.stem: A Contoso developer has pushed branch feature-report to GitHub and wants a teammate to check it before it reaches main. What should they open, and what does merging it do?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的一名开发者已把 feature-report 分支推送到 GitHub，希望队友在它进入 main 之前检查一下。应该打开什么？合并它会发生什么？
options: An issue; merging it closes the branch without changing main.
A fork; merging it copies the repository to another account.
A pull request; merging it brings the reviewed changes into main.
A release; merging it publishes the branch as a download.
questions.explain: A pull request is the right tool, because it shows every change in Files changed for review, and merging it adds the branch's commits to main.
questions.zhExplain: 应该使用 pull request，因为它在 Files changed 中显示每一处改动供评审，合并后会把该分支的提交加入 main。

questions.stem: At Tailwind Traders, a pull request from lab-01 into main is waiting. Which sequence correctly finishes the job?
questions.zhStem: 在 Tailwind Traders，一个从 lab-01 合并到 main 的 pull request 正在等待处理。哪个步骤顺序能正确完成这项工作？
options: Review Files changed, merge, then check the file on main.
Merge first, then delete main and rename lab-01.
Close the pull request, then push lab-01 again.
Run git commit on GitHub, then create a fork.
questions.explain: Review, merge and then verify on main is correct, because the Files changed tab lets you check every change, the merge brings it into main, and opening the file on main confirms the result.
questions.zhExplain: 先评审、再合并、最后在 main 上核对是正确的，因为 Files changed 标签页能检查每处改动，合并把它带入 main，在 main 上打开文件可以确认结果。

questions.stem: A Contoso intern clicks Fork on a course repository in GitHub and then looks for the files on their laptop. Where is the fork?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的一名实习生在 GitHub 上对一个课程仓库点击了 Fork，然后在自己的笔记本电脑上找这些文件。fork 在哪里？
options: In the laptop's Downloads folder as a zip file.
On GitHub, as a copy of the repository under their account.
Inside the original repository as a new branch.
In the laptop's staging area, waiting for git add.
questions.explain: The fork is on GitHub under the intern's account, because a fork is a server-side copy of a repository, and getting files onto the laptop needs a separate git clone.
questions.zhExplain: fork 在 GitHub 上该实习生的账户下，因为 fork 是仓库在服务器端的副本，要把文件放到笔记本电脑上还需要另外执行 git clone。

questions.stem: A Fabrikam developer pushes commits, but GitHub shows them without a link to their profile. How does GitHub decide which account a commit belongs to?
questions.zhStem: Fabrikam 的一名开发者推送了提交，但 GitHub 显示这些提交没有关联到他的个人资料。GitHub 如何决定一个提交属于哪个账户？
options: By the name of the computer the commit was made on.
By whichever account pushed the commit to GitHub.
By the branch name used for the commit.
By matching the commit's email address to an email on an account.
questions.explain: GitHub matches the commit's email address, because attribution uses the author email stored in the commit, so it must be an email added to the GitHub account.
questions.zhExplain: GitHub 通过匹配提交中的电子邮件地址来归属提交，因为归属依据的是提交里保存的作者邮箱，所以它必须是已添加到该 GitHub 账户的邮箱。
